systems.owner: National Agency for Population Register and Secure Titles (ANRPTS)
systems.tiers: citizen-facing application for requesting documents remotely: 677,000 activated accounts, 554,027 services completed, of which 406,871 civil-status extracts, 63,384 passport requests, 59,363 identity-card requests and 24,409 national electronic certificates, per ANRPTS at a seminar of 16-17 June 2026; launched December 2023, public from January 2024

note: The document describes Houwiyeti as an application through which citizens request civil-status extracts, passports and identity cards; it does not describe any office registering a birth or death, so there is no civil fact.
